NiagaraService.get_all_editable_settings:
X.get_all_editable_settings(system_path) -> NiagaraSystemEditableSettings or None
Get ALL editable settings on a Niagara system in one call.
This includes user parameters and all rapid iteration parameters from all emitters.
Use this to discover what can be modified, then use set_parameter() or
set_rapid_iteration_param() to change values.

Args:
    system_path (str): Full path to the Niagara system

Returns:
    NiagaraSystemEditableSettings or None: True if successful Example: settings = unreal.NiagaraService.get_all_editable_settings("/Game/VFX/NS_TeslaCoil")  # settings struct or None print(f"Found {settings.total_settings_count} editable settings") # List user parameters for p in settings.user_parameters: print(f"  {p.setting_path} ({p.value_type}): {p.current_value}") # Find color settings for p in settings.rapid_iteration_parameters: if "Color" in p.setting_path: print(f"  [{p.emitter_name}] {p.display_name}: {p.current_value}")

    out_settings (NiagaraSystemEditableSettings): All editable settings organized by category

MaterialNodeService.export_material_graph:
X.export_material_graph(material_path) -> str
Export the complete material graph as a JSON string for analysis or recreation.
Maps to action="export_graph"

Returns material settings, all expressions (type, position, properties),
all connections, and material output connections — everything needed to
recreate the material from scratch.

Args:
    material_path (str): Full path to the material

Returns:
    str: JSON string of complete graph, or empty string on failure Example: json_str = unreal.MaterialNodeService.export_material_graph("/Game/M_Landscape")
